name: GitHub Actions
subtitle: CI/CD built into GitHub
creator: GitHub
license: Proprietary service; many actions are open source
description: Event-driven workflows defined in YAML under .github/workflows. They run on GitHub-hosted or self-hosted runners to test, build, release and deploy code, with thousands of reusable actions in the Marketplace.

languages.youWrite: YAML workflows; custom actions in JS/TS, Docker or composite YAML

concepts.explanation: Events like push, pull_request or schedule.
Units of work and the commands inside them.
Run across versions and OSes in parallel.

codeSamples.label: YAML · .github/workflows/ci.yml
codeSamples.code:
name: CI
on: [push, pull_request]
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 24
          cache: npm
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm test

pairsWith.reason: Plan on PR, apply on merge

pros: Hosted runner prices cut up to 39% in January 2026
cons: YAML grows complex and debugging is slow
Third-party actions are a supply-chain risk (pin to SHAs)

pricing.summary: Free for public repos. Private repos include 2,000 min/mo (Free), 3,000 (Pro and Team) or 50,000 (Enterprise). Then Linux runners cost $0.006/min. Self-hosted runners stay free.
